set.body: Goal: add an idiomatic Scala 3 atlas subsystem to ScalaFIM, using neuroatlas as a semantic reference but not as an S3/list/plotting port. Scope: typed atlas identity and provenance, standard atlas descriptors, region metadata, coordinate-space transform planning, volumetric atlas payloads, parcel lookup/reduction/overlap/adjacency, JVM asset loaders for Schaefer/Glasser/Brainnetome/ASEG, deterministic fixtures, and docs. Non-goals: ggseg/plot_brain/Shiny-style visualization and hidden runtime TemplateFlow downloads in shared core. Done when child beads cover shared core, loader/cache IO, real standard-atlas fixtures, surface payload follow-up, docs, and acceptance tests.
set.title: Epic: ScalaFIM standard atlas subsystem
